/* OmniLert – force styling */
#omnilert-alert,
.emergency-alert-wrapper {
  position: fixed !important;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  width: 100vw;
  max-width: 100vw !important;
  z-index: 2147483647;
  text-align: center;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* Only offset header if OmniLert has content */
body:has(#omnilert-alert table) header.wp-block-template-part {
  top: 70px;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  body:has(#omnilert-alert table) header.wp-block-template-part {
    top: 100px;
  }
}

/* Target injected SmartBoard table */
.emergency-alert-wrapper table,
.emergency-alert-wrapper tr,
.emergency-alert-wrapper td {
  border: none !important;
  background-color: #006f54 !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  font-size: 1.35rem !important;
}

/* Row display fix */
.emergency-alert-wrapper tr {
  display: inline-block;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.emergency-alert-wrapper table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.emergency-alert-wrapper tr {
  display: table-row;
}

/* Subject emphasis */
.emergency-alert-wrapper td.SmartBoard_Subject {
  font-weight: bold !important;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-size: 1.3rem !important;
}

/* Mobile */
@media screen and (max-width: 600px) {
  .emergency-alert-wrapper table,
  .emergency-alert-wrapper tr,
  .emergency-alert-wrapper td {
    font-size: 1rem !important;
    display: table;
    margin: auto;
  }
}

/* OmniLert – de-emphasize date/time */
.emergency-alert-wrapper td.SmartBoard_DateTime {
  font-size: 0.9rem !important;
  opacity: 0.75; 
	  padding-left: 12px !important;
}

.emergency-alert-wrapper tr:first-child {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .emergency-alert-wrapper tr:first-child {
    display: block;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .emergency-alert-wrapper td.SmartBoard_Subject,
  .emergency-alert-wrapper td.SmartBoard_DateTime {
    display: block;
    padding: 2px 0 !important;
    white-space: normal;
